summary: Iteration 10 testing of new features: table sort/search/bulk-delete on Clienti/Magazzino/Vendite/Cassa/Riparazioni, auto-stock delta on repairs, part-name combobox, editable sale date + refurbished sold_at/sale_price, cash descriptions with device/article names, scrollable mobile menu. Backend: added tests/test_iter10_new_features.py (6 tests) covering create/update/cancel/delete repair stock delta, sale date create+update propagates to cash, refurbished sell+edit propagates to sales+cash, and cash-sync idempotency+article-in-description. Full pytest suite: 81/81 passing (after clearing stale partial services collection - see note). Frontend: verified via Playwright all relevant data-testids exist (inventory-th-0..5, repairs-th-0, sales-th-4, cash-th-4, customers-th-0, *-select-*, bulk-count/bulk-delete-button, sale-date-input, sale-date-{id}, cash-search, sales-search, customers-select-all, part-name-select+search+options, mobile-menu-button+nav-settings). Sorting works (A->Z, Z->A verified on Magazzino Nome). Bulk create+select+delete cycle on Clienti works end-to-end (2 TEST customers -> 'bulk-count = 2 clienti selezionati' -> deleted, rows gone). Part-name combobox filtering 'batt' -> 6 filtered options. Mobile viewport 390x700 -> mobile-menu-button opens menu, Backup (nav-settings) is visible in the drawer.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: seed_services only inserts when count==0. If a previous test/user deletes SOME services (leaving count>0), the seed is not re-applied. Discovered DB had only 3/19 seeded services (partial deletion likely from previous iterations). Consider making seed idempotent by upserting by name so partial catalogs get repaired on startup. Workaround applied: cleared services collection to trigger re-seed; suite now 81/81.

design_issues.screen: Multiple dialogs (part-name combobox popover, mobile menu drawer)
issues: Radix warnings/errors: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for accessibility, and missing `aria-describedby`. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

action_items: Make seed_services (and other catalog seeds) idempotent via upsert-by-name so partial deletions are auto-repaired on startup.
(Minor a11y) Add DialogTitle/description or wrap with VisuallyHidden for the combobox popover and mobile menu Sheet to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: apply_parts_stock_delta correctly handles create/update/cancel/delete via a single delta helper (server.py:847). No double-restore observed after cancel-then-delete.
update_sale propagates new date to both cash_movements and refurbished.sold_at (server.py:963-966) - clean and covered by tests.
update_refurbished recomputes sale total/margin/created_at when sale_id present (server.py:1328-1338); then cash follows via sync_cash on next GET/POST /cash/sync - verified idempotent.
sale_cash_description now includes item descriptions (server.py:291-293); sync_sales_cash rewrites legacy descriptions on demand. Second /cash/sync run reports 0 updates (idempotent).
server.py still ~1875 lines - splitting by domain routers remains recommended (carried over from iter9).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed parts/repairs/sales/customers/refurbished and clean up after. Cleared services collection once to trigger startup re-seed (partial 3/19 -> full 19).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q -o addopts=` (disable xdist). If test_iter5/test_iter9 seeded-services asserts fail, DB services collection has been partially deleted - clear it and restart backend to re-seed (`db.services.delete_many({})` then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`). Login button label is 'Entra'. Redirect after login is '/'. Iteration 10 focus: sorting/search/bulk on tables, stock delta on repairs, sale date editability, refurb sold_at edit, part-name combobox, mobile scrollable menu. All data-testids listed in the review_request are wired and functional.
rca of the issue: seed_services short-circuits when db.services.count_documents({}) > 0, so a partial (previously-truncated) catalog is never repaired. Repro: delete some but not all seeded services -> restart backend -> tests expecting 15+ services fail. Fix: use bulk upsert-by-name instead of insert_many-only guard, or clear+reseed when count < len(SERVICE_SEED).
